plain_what: Instead of training with smooth numbers and rounding at the end, choose each parameter change directly from the short list of values the final integer model can hold, while a checker guarantees that a set of already-correct answers stays correct. Every accepted step is then exactly servable and provably keeps what was learned.
how_it_works: Setting: the M2 native learner holds 1,920 Prefix and Generate coefficients as float masters, served as signed quarter-grid codes q/4 with q in [-7,7], giving 15 legal destinations per coordinate. A protected transaction commits a change only if (a) native scoring strictly lowers the pooled loss, (b) 17 reference roles and 380 original winners still win, and (c) the linearized guard test J delta >= -1e-10 ||delta|| holds. Residual feedback: take a continuous protected direction and round it onto the grid with 32 feedback rounds. Direct construction: a mixed-integer program per coordinate with binaries l and r choosing noop, lower or upper code (l + r <= 1, q between the stated bounds, delta = (q - q0)/4 + (l + r)(q0/4 - m)); minimize the original gradient dot delta subject to 380 unit-normalized guard rows, 1,960 variables, 440 constraints, 4,096 branch-and-bound nodes (pure Rust microlp, offline). Numerical repair: scale-aware LU pivot threshold tau_j = 32 n u max(column maxabs) with a normwise residual check on each fresh factor. The discrete-path analogue (moves that are legal by construction, committed only on strict joint improvement) now lives in discrete-learning and its BVG-K block-apply.
geometry: Quarter-grid Q4 code lattice of the H4/icosian-style finite signed tables (15 legal codes per coordinate), exact native integer token masses, protected-winner halfspaces. The discrete analogue uses signed-axis group bivector moves on E8 anchor-orbit roots.

Score at least one legal displacement on the frozen 512 panel and the 128 fresh rows, over at least 2 seeds, against a float-trained then quantized control at matched compute (D22 section 3 and 5(a))
A greedy legal coordinate search as a cheap baseline before any full MIP
Re-registration as an offline float sheet under D37 with a fresh TEST FITNESS: FIT, an owner release for the M2 hold, a separately scanned module and a D11 export gap
Or reuse the legal-by-construction idea on the discrete path (BVG-K block apply plus an admission-preserving acceptance rule) under its own FIT

rule_compat.D11: Aligned with it: the goal is that every accepted step is already in the servable integer code set, so there is no rounding loss. The solver itself is offline float LU and is not a serving component.
rule_compat.D23: The constructor and the guards use native integer token masses; the underlying M2 CE/pooled-ranking objective used softmax and softplus forms, which D23 bans, so a rerun needs a compliant objective.
rule_compat.D30: No dense matmul is needed by the constructor; it solves a sparse mixed-integer linear program with a pure-Rust backend. The guard Jacobians come from the M2 native stack.
rule_compat.D32_D37: Float LU and float gradients in the constructor were frozen by D32 item 5 and became re-registrable under D37 (offline float, separately scanned module). The D32-style discrete successor is active in discrete-learning.
